ceu: ✦ The square between Mercury and Uranus

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
From {H:1818952368000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
The square between Mercury and Uranus creates some tension between routine and conversations. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
From {H:1818952368000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
The square between Mercury and Uranus creates some tension between romance and money. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
From {H:1818952368000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
The square between Mercury and Uranus creates some tension between family and your image. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
From {H:1818952368000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.
The square between Mercury and Uranus creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
From {H:1818952368000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.
The square between Mercury and Uranus creates some tension between money and friendships. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
From {H:1818952368000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
The square between Mercury and Uranus creates some tension between your image and your career. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
From {H:1818952368000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
The square between Mercury and Uranus creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
From {H:1818952368000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.
The square between Mercury and Uranus creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
From {H:1818952368000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.
The square between Mercury and Uranus creates some tension between your career and relationships. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
From {H:1818952368000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
The square between Mercury and Uranus creates some tension between your horizons and routine. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
From {H:1818952368000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to home and family.
The square between Mercury and Uranus creates some tension between intimacy and romance. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Apologise for a careless word, if need be.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
From {H:1818952368000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.
The square between Mercury and Uranus creates some tension between relationships and family. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Put aside a small amount, just to build the habit.
